steps.title: Quantify extracted DNA
steps.instruction: Measure the concentration of each DNA extract (3–10 µL) using the Qubit dsDNA HS assay according to the manufacturer’s protocol.

substeps.instruction: Prepare Qubit working solution (1:200) by mixing 19.9 mL Qubit dsDNA HS buffer with 100 µL Qubit dsDNA HS reagent (20 mL total for 96 samples).
For each of the two standard tubes, add 190 µL working solution then 10 µL of the appropriate Qubit standard; vortex 2–3 s, avoid bubbles.
For each sample tube, add 200 µL minus the sample volume of working solution, then add 3–10 µL DNA (use 10 µL if concentration appears low); vortex 2–3 s, avoid bubbles.
Incubate all tubes at room temperature for 2 min.
Read standards and samples on the Qubit 2.0 fluorometer (select dsDNA High Sensitivity, read each tube ~3 s).
Record the displayed concentration; calculate original sample concentration using: Concentration = measured value × (200 / V), where V is the volume of DNA added in step above.

steps.title: Prepare DNA input layout
steps.instruction: Create a 96‑well plate layout, add the required amount of DNA to each well, and store if not proceeding immediately.

substeps.instruction: Using the Excel template “Template_AmpliSeq.xlsx”, assign sample IDs to wells.
Add 7.5 µL of (diluted) DNA to each well (typical input ~23 ng total; keep DNA ≤100 ng per reaction).
If DNA concentration is >100 ng/µL, dilute with low TE to ~1–10 ng/µL before adding.
Store the plate at 4 °C overnight or at –20 °C for longer periods (SAFE STOPPING POINT).

steps.title: Amplify targets with two primer pools
steps.instruction: Perform two parallel PCR reactions per sample using the AmpliSeq HiFi mix and the two custom primer pools.

substeps.instruction: Thaw on ice: 96‑well DNA plate, 5× AmpliSeq HiFi Mix (red cap), 2× Custom DNA pool 1 (red cap), 2× Custom DNA pool 2 (blue cap). Vortex each.
Briefly centrifuge the DNA plate; remove seal.
Add 5 µL 5× HiFi Mix to each well (using a multichannel pipette and 0.5 mL Combitip).
Mix, then transfer 5 µL of the DNA‑HiFi mixture to a new PCR plate labelled “pool 1” and 5 µL to another plate labelled “pool 2”.
To pool 1 plate add 5 µL 2× Custom DNA pool 1; to pool 2 plate add 5 µL 2× Custom DNA pool 2 (multichannel, 0.5 mL Combitip).
Seal plates, centrifuge briefly, remove bubbles, centrifuge again.

Run PCR (AMP_DNA program) on a thermocycler with heated lid 105 °C: 1 × 99 °C 2 min; 21 × (99 °C 15 s → 60 °C 8 min); Hold 10 °C up to 24 h. (SAFE STOPPING POINT: keep at 10 °C up to 24 h, longer storage at –25 °C to –15 °C).

steps.title: Partially digest amplicons (FuPa)
steps.instruction: Combine the two PCR products per sample and treat with FuPa to digest primers and partially digest amplicons.

substeps.instruction: Thaw on ice and vortex the two amplified‑pool plates; also thaw FuPa reagent (brown cap) on ice and, if proceeding directly, Switch solution (yellow cap) at RT.
Centrifuge plates, remove seals.
Combine 10 µL from pool 2 into the corresponding well of pool 1 (total 20 µL per sample).
Aliquot 30 µL FuPa reagent into each well of a clean 8‑well strip.
Using a multichannel pipette with 10 µL tips, add 2 µL FuPa to each combined‑pool well, mix, discard tips.

Seal, vortex briefly, centrifuge, then run the FUPA program: 1 × 50 °C 10 min; 1 × 55 °C 10 min; 1 × 62 °C 20 min; Hold 10 °C up to 1 h. (SAFE STOPPING POINT: hold at 10 °C up to 1 h, longer storage at –25 °C to –15 °C).

steps.title: Ligate dual indexes
steps.instruction: Add Switch solution, index adapters, and DNA ligase to each digested sample to attach i7 and i5 indexes.

substeps.instruction: Thaw on ice/RT: Switch solution (yellow cap), AmpliSeq CD Index set (A‑D), DNA ligase (blue cap). Vortex each.
Equilibrate AMPure XP beads to RT (≥30 min) and vortex.
Centrifuge the plate with digested amplicons, remove seals.
Add 4 µL Switch solution to each well (multichannel, 0.2 mL Combitip – two 4 µL transfers).
Add 2 µL appropriate CD Index (from the index plate) to each well (multichannel, 10 µL tips).
Aliquot 30 µL DNA ligase reagent into a clean 8‑well strip; transfer 2 µL ligase to each well, mix.

Seal, vortex briefly, centrifuge, then run LIGATE program: 1 × 22 °C 30 min; 1 × 68 °C 5 min; 1 × 72 °C 5 min; Hold 10 °C up to 24 h. (SAFE STOPPING POINT: hold at 10 °C up to 24 h, longer storage at –25 °C to –15 °C).

steps.title: First library cleanup (AMPure beads)
steps.instruction: Bind libraries to AMPure XP beads, wash, and elute into the same well.

substeps.instruction: Equilibrate AMPure XP beads to RT (≥30 min), vortex.
Prepare fresh 70 % ethanol (35 mL 100 % EtOH + 15 mL nuclease‑free water).
Centrifuge the indexed‑library plate, remove seal.
Add 30 µL AMPure XP beads to each well (multichannel, 2.5 or 5 mL Combitip).
Seal, vortex, ensure homogenous mixture, centrifuge low speed (~500–1,000 rpm).
Incubate RT 5 min, place on magnetic stand until clear (~2 min).
Remove and discard all supernatant with a multichannel pipette (200–300 µL tips).
Wash twice: add 150 µL 70 % EtOH, incubate >30 s until clear, remove supernatant each time.
Air‑dry beads on magnetic stand ≥10 min (avoid overdrying).
Proceed immediately to library amplification (next step).

steps.title: Amplify library
steps.instruction: Perform PCR amplification of the bead‑bound libraries using universal primers.

substeps.instruction: Thaw on ice: four tubes of 1× Lib Amp mix (black cap) and two tubes of 10× Library Amp primers (pink cap); vortex.
Prepare master mix for 96 reactions (make 100×): 45 µL 1× Lib Amp mix + 5 µL 10× primers per reaction → 50 µL per reaction, 5 000 µL total for 96 wells; vortex and centrifuge.
Remove the library plate from the magnet, add 50 µL master mix to each well (multichannel, 5 mL Combitip).

Seal, vortex briefly, centrifuge low speed, then run AMP_7 program: 1 × 98 °C 2 min; 7 × (98 °C 15 s → 64 °C 1 min); Hold 10 °C up to 24 h. (SAFE STOPPING POINT: hold at 10 °C up to 24 h, longer storage at –25 °C to –15 °C).

steps.title: Second library cleanup (two‑round AMPure)
steps.instruction: Perform a second bead‑based purification to remove primers and concentrate libraries.

substeps.instruction: Equilibrate AMPure XP beads to RT (≥30 min) and vortex.
Prepare fresh 70 % EtOH as before.
Centrifuge the amplified‑library plate, keep seal on.
First round: add 25 µL AMPure XP beads to each well (multichannel, 2.5 mL Combitip), seal, vortex briefly, low‑speed centrifuge, incubate RT 5 min.
Place on magnetic stand ≥5 min, transfer the entire supernatant (~75 µL) to a new 96‑well plate (beads remain in original wells).
Second round: add 60 µL AMPure XP beads to each well of the new plate, seal, vortex, low‑speed centrifuge, incubate RT 5 min.
Place on magnetic stand, wait until clear (~5 min), discard supernatant with multichannel pipette.
Wash twice with 150 µL 70 % EtOH, incubate >30 s, remove supernatant each wash.
Air‑dry beads ≥5 min, then add 30 µL low TE buffer to each well, seal, vortex, low‑speed centrifuge.
Place on magnetic stand, wait until clear (~5 min), transfer 27 µL supernatant (library) to a new 96‑well plate.
Store plate at –25 °C to –15 °C (up to 30 days) if not proceeding (SAFE STOPPING POINT).

steps.title: Quantify libraries
steps.instruction: Determine library concentration using either KAPA qPCR or Qubit dsDNA HS assay.

substeps.instruction: OPTION 1 – KAPA qPCR:
Thaw all KAPA kit components; add 1 mL 10× primer premix to 5 mL 2× SYBR FAST qPCR Master mix; vortex.
Prepare 1:1 000 000 dilution of each library in 10 mM Tris‑HCl pH 8.0–8.5 + 0.05 % Tween 20 (three successive 100× dilutions).
Set up 96‑well qPCR plate: 6 µL master mix per well, 4 µL water for NTCs, 4 µL each DNA standard (6 standards), 4 µL each diluted library (triplicate).
Run qPCR (KAPA protocol): 1 × 95 °C 5 min; 35 × (95 °C 30 s → 60 °C 45 s); melt curve 65–95 °C.
OPTION 2 – Qubit:
Prepare working solution (1:200) as in step 1 (20 mL for 96 samples).
Add 190 µL working solution to each of two standard tubes, 10 µL standard, vortex.
Add 197 µL working solution to each library tube, then 3 µL library (adjust volume if library is very low or high).
Incubate RT 2 min, read standards then samples on Qubit 2.0 as in step 1.
Calculate original library concentration: Concentration = measured value × (200 / V) where V is the volume of library added (3 µL).

steps.title: Dilute and pool libraries to 2 nM
steps.instruction: Normalize each library to 2 nM, then combine equal volumes to create the final pool.

substeps.instruction: Thaw low TE buffer (from kit) at RT.
Using the concentrations obtained above, calculate the volume needed to reach 2 nM for each library (formula for Qubit: (c × 10⁶) / (660 × library size); assume 350 bp if size unknown).
If a library is already ≤2 nM, add 6 µL undiluted library to the dilution plate (ensure at least 3 µL total volume).
Dilute each library in a 96‑well plate to a final volume ≤200 µL; keep final volume ≤200 µL to avoid overflow.
Pool equal volumes: transfer 5 µL from each well of a row into an 8‑well strip, mix 10× by pipetting, then combine the eight row pools into a single 1.5 mL LoBind tube.
If more than 96 samples, pool all 2 nM libraries together, ensuring different index sets are not mixed incorrectly.
Store the pooled library on ice; if not sequencing immediately, keep at –20 °C up to 1 week.

steps.title: Prepare Illumina sample sheet
steps.instruction: Create the sample plate and sample sheet files required for MiSeq run using Illumina Experiment Manager.

substeps.instruction: Open Experiment Manager, select “Create Sample Plate”. Choose the appropriate AmpliSeq CD Index plate (A‑D), click Next.
Enter a unique plate name (no spaces/special characters). Set Index Reads = 2 (Dual). Click Next.
In Table view, paste or type unique Sample IDs for each well; apply default index layout or manually assign Index1/Index2.
Validate that all entries turn white (valid). Click Finish and save the plate file.
Create Sample Sheet: select “Create Sample Sheet”, choose MiSeq, Next.
Select Application = Other → FASTQ Only (or DNA Amplicon if using on‑board analysis). Click Next.
Enter Reagent Kit Barcode (RGT########) from SBS kit label.
Select Library Prep Workflow = AmpliSeq Library PLUS for Illumina; select Index Adapter set used (A‑D or 384).
Set Index Reads = 2, enter experiment metadata, set Paired‑End, set Read 1 and Read 2 cycles to 301 (for 600‑cycle kit). Enable Adapter Trimming.
Proceed to “Select Samples”, import the previously saved sample plate, select all wells, Add Selected Samples, Finish and save the *.csv sample sheet.
Review the CSV in Excel to ensure no spaces or special characters in Sample IDs.

steps.title: Denature and dilute pooled library
steps.instruction: Prepare the final 10 pM library, add PhiX spike‑in, and dilute to the loading concentration.

substeps.instruction: Prepare fresh 0.2 N NaOH: mix 800 µL nuclease‑free water with 200 µL 1.0 N NaOH; invert to mix; use within 12 h.
Thaw HT1 buffer (MiSeq v3 kit) at RT; keep on ice after thaw.
Denature: combine 5 µL pooled library with 5 µL 0.2 N NaOH, vortex, brief spin, incubate RT 5 min.
Add 5 µL 200 mM Tris‑HCl pH 7.0, then 985 µL pre‑chilled HT1 buffer → final 10 pM library; vortex, spin, keep on ice.
Dilute to final loading concentration (600 µL total):
If libraries were quantified by KAPA, dilute to 18 pM; if by Qubit, dilute to 7 pM.
Add 1 %–5 % PhiX spike‑in (5 % recommended): e.g., 570 µL 7 pM library + 30 µL 7 pM PhiX → 7 pM library pool with 5 % PhiX.
Keep the final 600 µL pool on ice until loading.

steps.title: Load MiSeq and start run
steps.instruction: Perform MiSeq cartridge preparation, load the library pool, and initiate the sequencing run.

substeps.instruction: Perform a pre‑run wash in MiSeq Control Software (select Wash).
Thaw the MiSeq V3 reagent cartridge in a water bath (only the base) for 1–2 h; invert 10 times to mix, ensure no precipitates.
If not loading immediately, keep cartridge on ice or at 2–8 °C (max 6 h).
Open the “Load Samples” reservoir seal, clean foil, pierce with a clean 1 mL tip.
Load 600 µL of the prepared 7 pM library pool with 5 % PhiX into the reservoir (avoid touching seal).
In MiSeq Control Software, select Sequence → Local Run Manager → Create Run.
Choose analysis module: GenerateFASTQ (or DNA Amplicon if on‑board variant calling is desired).
Import the sample sheet created earlier, verify samples and indexes, give run a name, and Save Run.
Proceed through the Local Run Manager prompts:
Load the flow cell (clean with Kimwipe/ethanol, place, close clamp).
Replace wash bottle with PR2 bottle (invert PR2 bottle, open, lock handle).
Insert the loaded reagent cartridge into the reagent chiller.
Confirm read type (Paired‑End), read length (2 × 300 bp + index reads), and other parameters; edit if needed.
Start the run; the 600‑cycle V3 kit run takes ~56 h.
After completion, retrieve FASTQ files from the MiSeq or download from BaseSpace.
